entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: IT'S ALL BECAUSE OF SLACKERS LIKE[n]YOU THAT THE SECTION CHIEF IS SO[n]RUDE TO ME!

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: HE'S ALWAYS CALLING ME [clr 2]USELESS[clr 27][n]OR [clr 2]UNRELIABLE[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: ISN'T IT SO UNFAIR THAT I'M THE[n]ONLY ONE WHO HAS TO DEAL[n]WITH THIS ALL THE TIME?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sounds like this guy REALLY doesn't like[n]the section chief.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Let's try and pump him for information,[n]Joker!
Do you hate the section chief?
What's the section chief like?

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: EVERYONE HATES THAT GUY!

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: HE MARCHES AROUND TELLING US ALL[n]WE'RE [clr 2]USELESS[clr 27]. WE TRY TO STAY AS FAR[n]FROM HIM AS WE CAN!

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: UGH... I WISH SOMEONE WOULD JUST[n]TAKE CARE OF THE GUY FOR US.

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: "INSUFFERABLE" IS PROBABLY THE[n]MOST ACCURATE WORD FOR HIM!

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: HE HAS THE NERVE TO CALL EVERYONE[n][clr 2]USELESS[clr 27] DESPITE HIM BEING THE ONE[n]SLACKING OFF ALL THE TIME!

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: DAMMIT! IF ONLY THE SECTION CHIEF[n]WOULD JUST DISAPPEAR, I'D BECOME[n]A SHOO-IN FOR A PROMOTION...
I could make that happen, if...
Cut us a deal and we'll see.

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: YOU WHAT!? YOU MEAN YOU'LL[n]REALLY GET RID OF HIM FOR ME?

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: ...NO, WAIT! YOU'RE LYING! YOU JUST[n]WANT INFORMATION ON THE SECTION[n]CHIEF!

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: ...ARGH, DAMMIT! I COULD GET[n]RID OF THE SECTION CHIEF SO[n]EASILY WITH MY [clr 2]WIND[clr 27] POWER!

entries.speaker: Chief Clerk Robot
entries.en: BUT, I'M... I'M JUST TOO SCARED[n]TO ACTUALLY DO IT... UGH!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mweheheh, so the section chief is weak[n]to [clr 2]Wind[clr 27], is he?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We didn't get any deets on the chief[n]director, but this is still good!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Looks like this guy's done chatting,[n]so let's clean up, Joker!
